notes: TOP200 NAWA is a national Polish NAWA scheme (Junior/Senior Fellow) with no single attached institution; successful researchers contract with a Polish university or institute of their choosing. No programme-level professors exist. The nawa.gov.pl/en/students/top200 URL currently returns a 404 (site restructured), but the programme is by design institution-agnostic. No supervisors to verify.

Bekker NAWA Programme is a Polish national outbound mobility fellowship (3-24 months at a foreign research centre chosen by the applicant, any discipline, no host-country restriction). Supervisors abroad are chosen per applicant after selection, so no institutional professor is attached to the scheme. nawa.gov.pl/en/scientists/bekker currently 404s (site restructured); not_applicable stands regardless.

Walczak NAWA Programme is a Polish national mobility grant for medical/pharmaceutical/health researchers attached to Polish institutions, funding 1-6 month teaching/research/clinical stays at foreign host centres selected by the applicant. No host professors are attached to the scheme. nawa.gov.pl/en/scientists/walczak currently 404s (site restructured); not_applicable stands regardless.

Visegrad Scholarship Program is run by the International Visegrad Fund and funds 1-2 semesters at more than 190 accredited higher-education institutions across Central/Eastern Europe chosen by the scholar. It is a multilateral intergovernmental scheme with no attached institution or named supervising professors. (Direct fetch of visegradfund.mvcr.cz/en/scholarships failed with a transport error, but the scheme has no institutional attachment by design.)

Lane Kirkland Scholarship Program (study.gov.pl, Polish-American Freedom Foundation / NAWA) is a non-degree professional development scholarship spread across about five Polish academic centers (Warsaw, Krakow, Wroclaw, Poznan, Lublin), with the host university and academic advisor selected later by the programme office; no named supervisor is published on the official source page. Kirkland Research track likewise works 'under the supervision of an academic advisor' without a named professor. Not applicable.

Poland My First Choice NAWA is a government scholarship under which applicants choose their own Polish university and field of study and apply for admission independently (call 19/2026). The scheme has no attached institution or supervising faculty. nawa.gov.pl/en/students/poland-my-first-choice currently 404s (site restructured); not_applicable stands regardless.

professors.title: Professor (prof. dr hab. inz., C.Eng.), UNESCO AGH Chairholder, Director of the AGH-UNESCO Centre
professors.institution_name: AGH University of Science and Technology (Akademia Gorniczo-Hutnicza im. Stanislawa Staszica), Krakow, Poland
professors.department_name: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics, Department of Manufacturing Systems; UNESCO Chair for Science, Technology and Engineering Education / Centrum Miedzynarodowej Promocji Technologii i Edukacji AGH - UNESCO
research_areas: University-industry cooperation in engineering research and training
professors.evidence_quote_or_summary: UNESCO AGH Chair official site lists the Chairholder as 'Prof. Dr hab. C.Eng. Janusz Szpytko, Tel. +48 12 617 5109, E-mail: unesco@agh.edu.pl' at the AGH University, which hosts the UNESCO Chair to which this fellowship programme is attached. The official AGH staff directory (skos.agh.edu.pl) confirms he is a professor at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics, Department of Manufacturing Systems, and Dyrektor (Director) of Centrum Miedzynarodowej Promocji Technologii i Edukacji AGH - UNESCO. The programme pages state fellows carry out their research under an AGH staff member / AGH project leader: 'A candidate for a scholarship should implement the scholarship under the supervision of an AGH University staff member' (edition 2023C page) and the 2024A call for projects states the fellowship programme is carried out 'pod opieka samodzielnego pracownika naukowego AGH (kierownika projektu)' (under the supervision of an independent AGH researcher, the project leader).

notes: Programme is anchored at the UNESCO Chair for Science, Technology and Engineering Education at AGH University of Krakow (30 research fellowships per edition, 6 months). The Chair Centrum's leadership page confirms Prof. Janusz Szpytko is the only professor-level head; remaining Centrum staff are administrative (mgr inz.). Individual fellowship-project leaders (kierownicy projektow) are named only in the UNESCO announcement-letter PDF (Annex III), which is a binary PDF and could not be text-extracted here; programme rules confirm every fellow works under an AGH researcher/project leader.
